// DB_CONNECTION_STRING: Set via environment or secret store — never committed.
// Auth: Local  — passwords in the users table, PBKDF2-hashed. No default account ships with the product:
set Auth__BootstrapAdminEmail and Auth__BootstrapAdminPassword once to create the first admin.
Ldap   — binds against LDAP/Active Directory; ResolveDesk never stores the password.
Roles come from group membership via Ldap:CoordinatorGroup / Ldap:AdminGroup.
Oidc   — two shapes. Set Oidc:ClientId and this API runs the code flow itself (PKCE) and issues
its own token, so SSO works beside a password and a passkey. Leave ClientId empty and
the SPA obtains a provider token which this API validates instead.
Jwt:SigningKey must come from the environment (Auth__Jwt__SigningKey), at least 32 bytes.
// Auth (methods): Methods is a list, not a choice: Password, Oidc and Passkey can all be on at once.
Provider says which backend checks a password (Local | Ldap) and is ignored without Password.
Totp adds an optional second factor; Required refuses sign-in until an account has enrolled.
Passkey.Origins must list the exact origins the browser reports, or every assertion is rejected.
Invitations.BaseUrl is where setup links point — the API returns the URL, it never sends mail.
// Ai: Provider: None | Ollama | OpenAi | AzureOpenAi | Gemini.
OpenAi also covers LM Studio, vLLM, llama.cpp and OpenRouter — point BaseUrl at them.
Chat and Embedding are independent: run embeddings locally and chat hosted, or the reverse.
ApiKey belongs in an env var (Ai__Chat__ApiKey), not in this file.
Dimensions must match the pgvector column; changing it needs a migration + re-embed.
MinSimilarity is a floor, not a separator — its scale belongs to the embedding model.
Re-measure it after changing models: node tools/validate-retrieval.mjs
// Search: TextSearchConfig is baked into the generated tickets.search_tsv column; changing it after the schema exists needs a migration. Use 'simple' for languages Postgres has no stemmer for.
